name: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Ruler of the Skies
summary: Look up, and you might catch a glimpse of a fearsome Pokémon twisting through the night sky. Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket’s next expansion, Ruler of the Skies, is now available, starring the Legendary Mega Rayquaza ex.
